vocabulary.definition_vi: Chỉ số hiệu suất chính – chỉ số đo lường mức độ đạt được mục tiêu.

vocabulary.usage_note: Always refer to KPIs in context of specific goals. Plural: KPIs

vocabulary.definition_en: The percentage of users who take a desired action (purchase, sign-up) out of total visitors

vocabulary.example_sentence: We improved the landing page and saw the conversion rate jump from 2% to 5%.
vocabulary.usage_note: Calculated as: (conversions / total visitors) × 100%

vocabulary.definition_en: Comparing two versions of content (A and B) to see which performs better

vocabulary.definition_en: A metric measuring the level of interaction (likes, comments, shares) relative to reach or followers

vocabulary.definition_en: The customer journey stages from awareness to purchase: Awareness → Interest → Decision → Action
